candidate_acquisition_families: M3 boundary x positive correction toward Keyhole

decision.CORRECTION_SIGNAL_NUMERICALLY_UNRELIABLE: Phase 1.14 sensitivity convergence <0.80, or median B80 L100/L1000 path Jaccard <0.25 together with abs AULC change >=0.01
decision.CORRECTION_SIGNAL_PARTIAL: not numerically unreliable and at least two of: top net-fix CI >0; q20-like enrichment CI >1; early net-fix CI >0; Keyhole net-fix CI >0
decision.CORRECTION_SIGNAL_SUPPORTED: top-correction net fix rate CI >0, top-correction q20-like enrichment CI >1, and early B16-24 net fix rate CI >0

inference.candidate_rows: descriptive; repeated candidates are not independent

novelty_rule: No broad novelty claim; only a narrow application/formulation possibility after comparison with discrepancy BED, physics-residual acquisition, physics-prior GPC, BALD, and level-set acquisition.
